title: Police in northern Germany search for suspects after car ramming overnight injures several
summary: A person intentionally drove into a group of people in a northern German town, police have said. The suspects fled on foot and remain at large.

image.caption: Details of the incident, including the number of suspects or motive, were initially unclearImage: Moritz Frankenberg/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: A BMW was driven ​deliberately ‌into a group of people, leaving ‌four to five of ‌them ​with some serious but not life-threatening injuries in Neustadt am Rübenberge in the state of Lower Saxony late on Monday night, police said on Tuesday morning.
A police patrol making routine traffic checks intervened, shooting at the car to stop it.
An unknown number of suspects fled the car on foot and remain at large, a police spokesperson said.
"The sequence of events and the exact roles of those involved are still under investigation," the spokesperson added.

blocks.caption: A forensic analysis of the crime scene was ongoing, a police spokesperson saidImage: Moritz Frankenberg/dpa/picture alliance

blocks.text: Preliminary findings indicate the individuals involved knew each other and that the perpetrators likely targeted the group of people and were not acting at random, the spokesperson said, adding that a forensic analysis was ongoing.
A reporter for the German DPA news agency described several damaged cars, with flat tires, a smashed rear window and bullet holes.
This article will be updated as more information becomes available.
